label: SYNTHETIC DEMO: Agung ash closes Bali while Sakurajima erupts, 14 Oct 2026 (invented data)
notes: Synthetic demo data, invented for TEPHRA's product demo by scripts/make_demo_case.py (seeded, no network); nothing in this case was recorded or happened. Real: the volcanoes, airports, FIRs, airline callsigns and their usual routes (data/volcanoes.json, data/airports.json, data/routes_apac.json, VRS standing data CC0); each flight flies the great circle of its callsign's leg at a semicircular-rule level. Invented: every SIGMET, VONA, JMA eruption report, Tokyo and Darwin VAA, METAR, TAF, wind profile and aircraft position and time, each stored under the URL the live poller requests so the same parsers read it. The HTML and XML pages say so in a comment; the JSON answers cannot. Story (UTC, 14 Oct 2026): Agung erupts at 0542Z; the observatory puts the ash higher than every official product (0700Z notice) and moving south while the SIGMET says west and Darwin south-west; WADD's METARs and amended TAF report VA; Darwin's next VAA at 0748Z raises the top to FL380. Sakurajima's Tokyo VAA closes the event at 0630Z, JMA reports a new eruption at 0652Z and RJJJ a SIGMET while that VAA is in force. Semeru and Dukono carry routine SIGMETs and VAAs. Not in this case: satellite frames and raw Himawari data (TEPHRA credits frames to JMA or NICT; an invented picture would pass for theirs). Never scored by the backtest. Demo window 0705Z-0715Z (TEPHRA_REPLAY_START, TEPHRA_REPLAY_END), after the last product in it, so every minute of the loop shows the same picture.
